_help: Every trait a pet can have. See src/game/traits.ts for what each number does. A trait with "special": true is only for characters that list it under "traits" in src/data/characters.json. inheritChance is the percent chance a little one gets one of its parents' traits.

traits.name: Playful
traits.about: Fidgets a lot, stays happy longer after play, and gets bored sooner.

traits.name: Greedy
traits.about: Loves every snack, not only its favourite, and looks hungry sooner.

traits.name: Shy
traits.about: Fidgets less, and is startled for a while when someone visits.

traits.name: Sleepy
traits.about: Moves slowly, is grumpy when woken, and looks tired sooner.

traits.name: Cheery
traits.about: Keeps smiling, and only gets sad when things are really bad.
